findings.summary: xtask/shard-timings.txt is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The dependents list for docs/spec.toml leaves out several readers of the file, including xtask/tests/spec.rs, the validator of the whole file.
findings.evidence: Grep for `spec.toml` (read in this review) finds readers the list does not name. xtask/tests/spec.rs:95 reads the real file and checks every requirement's source quote, id uniqueness, mechanism, owner and `status:` measure (check_how_it_is_met at 194-213; every_active_requirement_has_a_mechanism_an_owner_and_a_measure at 627-655). Others: crates/athena-core/src/status.rs:1640,1673, iris.rs:229, preflight.rs:599 and gh/tests.rs:5369 (`include_str!` plus parse_spec), crates/athena-cli/src/pushback.rs:213 and strategy.rs:410 (toml::from_str on the real file), and crates/athena-core/tests/divergence.rs:79. I read each one: each looks up its own id and none asserts a count of `none` mechanisms, so the risk is low. But the plan's claim that it covers 'Other tests that read docs/spec.toml' is incomplete. Fix: Add each omitted reader to the dependents list, with the reason it is unaffected. For xtask/tests/spec.rs, say that the edited entry keeps its source quote and has a non-empty mechanism, an owner, and a measure containing `status:`, and that `cargo test --locked` (criterion 5) runs these tests on the final tree.
findings.location: Dependents, entry 'docs/spec.toml content: Other tests that read docs/spec.toml'

findings.summary: Soundness: the plan reduces 'Athena's own records as primary evidence' to 'at least one Record source', and it does not check coverage of each mechanism.
findings.evidence: The requirement text (docs/spec.toml:2995) says 'For each instance the study explains how each mechanism works ... using Athena's own records as primary evidence'. Under the plan, an Athena explanation with ten non-record sources and one blank-free Record passes. An instance with no explanation for some mechanism produces no gap, because `check(&[])` returns empty. The accepted reading defines the rule as presence, so this is within scope, but the measure and module doc should not suggest more. Fix: In the module doc and the spec measure, state both limits: Record presence stands in for 'primary', and missing mechanisms are not detected. Optionally, make the Record gap fire when no Record is listed first, or accept an expected mechanism list per instance and add a `Gap::Unexplained`.

findings.summary: Step 3 puts `pub mod mechanism_explanation;` after `labeled`/`lab`, but alphabetically it belongs after `manage`.
findings.evidence: lib.rs lists `pub mod lab; labeled; land; learning; manage; method_experiment;`. `mechanism_explanation` sorts between `manage` (128) and `method_experiment` (129). rustfmt reorders consecutive `mod` items, so placing it after `labeled` would fail `cargo fmt --check` until reformatted. Fix: Insert it between `pub mod manage;` and `pub mod method_experiment;`.

findings.summary: Hardcoding D176 can collide with a parallel job that appends to the shared append-only decision log.
findings.evidence: docs/decisions.md is in SHARED_APPEND_ONLY (crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs:537, crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs:976). Rule::DecisionEntries (mirrors.rs:23) requires a new entry to take the next id. Another job landing first with D176 would make this entry fail that rule. Fix: Say the entry takes the next id after the last `## D<n>` heading in the producer's base, which is D176 at this snapshot.

findings.summary: The criterion-6 demonstration has no 'fails without' line and no seam.
findings.evidence: The other demonstrations each state a failure case and a test seam. Criterion 6 gives only `git diff --stat` and an observation. Append-only is enforced by Rule::DecisionEntries and the append-only check in crates/athena-core/src/mirrors.rs:241-265, which the plan does not cite. Fix: Add a fails-without line: removing or editing an earlier line makes the mirrors append-only check report 'docs/decisions.md is append-only'. Name that check, plus the diff of CHANGELOG.md, as the seam.

summary: The plan fits the request and the accepted reading. It follows the S3-02 precedent closely: a pure `check` in a new athena-core module, an integration test modelled on study_instance_split.rs, the spec entry filled with `status: not shown`, the shard-timings line, a CHANGELOG bullet and an appended D176. I confirmed these in the snapshot: OLY-B-S4-01 is at docs/spec.toml:2991 with mechanism `none`. The last decision is D175 (docs/decisions.md:5063). The S3-02 commit c9fb473 also changed xtask/shard-timings.txt. ci_shards.rs:411-421 does require every test unit to be listed. The helpers used by study_instance_split.rs:259-312 exist, and no decision-links entry governs the touched paths. The demonstrations use real seams (`check`, `parse_spec`, `spec_gaps`, `measure_problem`) and would fail without the change. One finding is major: the dependents list for docs/spec.toml leaves out several readers. The most important is xtask/tests/spec.rs, the structural validator of the whole spec file. I checked each omitted reader, and each looks up its own requirement id, so the real risk is low; the list still needs completing. The minor points: the check reduces "primary evidence" to "at least one Record", and it does not check that every mechanism of an instance is explained. The plan puts the lib.rs `pub mod` line in the wrong sorted position. The D176 id could collide with a parallel job. The criterion-6 demonstration has no fails-without line and no seam.
